explanation: 52 factorial, the number of possible orders, is about 8 followed by 67 zeros. Earth holds roughly 10 to the power 50 atoms, so a well-shuffled deck almost certainly holds an order never seen before.

claims.text: The number of possible orders of a 52-card deck, 52 factorial, is greater than the number of atoms in Earth.
52 factorial is about 8 followed by 67 zeros.
Earth contains roughly 10 to the power 50 atoms.
A well-shuffled deck is almost certainly in an order that has never occurred before.
